selection_basis: A candidate must be a significant human DEG, include at least one additional evidence category, and have at least one cross-dimensional network support category (hub support across at least two centrality metrics, measured network drift, or observed lost/gained interactions). DEG alone, module association alone, and orthology alone do not qualify. Eligible candidates are ordered by evidence-category count, adjusted p-value, and absolute log2 fold change; no composite biomarker score is used.
limitations: Candidates are research-only and have not undergone independent or clinical validation.
Drift and lost/gained interaction evidence derive from related saved network comparisons and are not independent validation.
The human and mouse cancer networks differ substantially in size and density.
